title: relay_client: TLS_CLIENT_CONFIG install_default silently swallows error
description: TLS_CLIENT_CONFIG is a LazyLock that calls CryptoProvider::install_default().unwrap_or(()) then calls ClientConfig::builder(). If install_default returns an error it is silently discarded via unwrap_or(()). The subsequent ClientConfig::builder() call may still succeed using a previously-installed provider, but if no provider was installed, the code panics with an unhelpful message. The error from install_default should be propagated or logged.
